chunks: Y narró Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari desde Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqtini, quien dijo:
Cuando la gente discrepó en el asunto de Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (que la paz sea con él), recopilé de sus preguntas, las que le fueron hechas y él respondió, quince mil preguntas.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا: Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (Imam Ali ibn Musa)
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام: Que la paz sea con él

ai.seo_question: ¿Cuántas preguntas recopiló Abdullah ibn Ja'far del Imam al-Rida sobre su Imamato?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrates that to resolve sectarian disputes regarding the Imamate of Imam al-Rida (a.s.), he compiled fifteen thousand questions and answers, a massive corpus known as *al-Masa'il al-Khamsa wa-l-Alf*. This compilation serves as a crucial scholarly tool for establishing the Imam's theological authority and clarifying doctrinal nuances in the face of competing claims. The sheer volume underscores the Imam's role as the definitive interpreter of divine law during a period of intense intellectual and political contestation. How many questions did Abdullah ibn Ja'far collect from Imam al-Rida regarding his Imamate? Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (Imam Ali ibn Musa) Peace be upon him Questions/Issues Fifteen thousand
